correctness.rationale: The proof was reconstructed from the focal definitions. Uniform perfectness yields a disjoint subball at a fixed relative scale; doubling turns its positive mass into a uniform fractional mass loss; iteration gives the stated \(\kappa\). The Lipschitz cutoff is then controlled on every Campanato ball, with the only new exponent condition \(\lambda<p+\kappa\). The Hölder witness and exponent cancellation force \(\mu(B(x,r))\ge C r^Q\). The published Theorem 3.6(ii) supplies the converse. No experiment or partial enumeration substitutes for proof.
